description: Experience the viral sensation of Korean cream cheese garlic bread, a delightful fusion of sweet and savory flavors. This popular street food features a soft, fluffy bun generously filled with a sweet cream cheese mixture and drenched in a rich, garlicky butter sauce. Perfectly golden and irresistible, it's a treat that will transport your taste buds straight to Korea.

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Take 4-6 round bread buns. Using a sharp knife, cut each bun into 6 or 8 equal wedges, but do not cut all the way through the bottom. The wedges should still be attached at the base. Place the cut buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and heavy cream. Mix until smooth and well combined. Transfer the cream cheese mixture into a piping bag fitted with a round tip, or use a spoon.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling into the crevices of each cut bread bun. Ensure each wedge receives a generous amount of filling.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Dip
instructions.text: In another bowl, whisk together the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, mayonnaise, milk, beaten egg, and honey or maple syrup. Mix until all ingredients are thoroughly combined. Stir in the dried parsley flakes.

instructions.title: Dip and Preheat
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Generously dip each cream cheese-filled bread bun into the garlic butter mixture, ensuring all cut surfaces and the top are well coated. You can also brush the mixture over the bread if dipping is too messy. Place the dipped buns back on the baking sheet.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cream cheese filling is warm and slightly gooey. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.

instructions.title: Serve Warm
instructions.text: Remove the Korean cream cheese garlic bread from the oven. Let it cool for a few minutes before serving. Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh parsley if desired. Enjoy warm as a delightful snack or side.

tips: For the best texture, use fresh, soft brioche or milk buns as the base. If using slightly older bread, a quick steam can soften it.
Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing to achieve a smooth, lump-free filling that's easy to pipe.
To prevent the garlic from burning during baking, you can lightly sauté it in a small amount of butter before adding to the dip mixture.
article:
Get ready to tantalize your taste buds with a culinary sensation that has taken the world by storm: Korean cream cheese garlic bread. This isn't your average garlic bread; it's a delightful fusion of sweet, savory, creamy, and garlicky flavors, all wrapped up in a soft, pillowy bread. Originating from the bustling bakeries of South Korea, this unique treat has captivated foodies with its irresistible combination of rich cream cheese filling, fragrant garlic butter, and a perfectly toasted exterior. If you’re looking to elevate your baking game and impress your friends and family, mastering this Korean baking staple is a must.

## What is Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread?

At its heart, Korean cream cheese garlic bread is a deeply satisfying sweet and savory bread dish. Unlike traditional savory garlic bread found in Western cuisines, the Korean version introduces a decadent, slightly sweetened cream cheese filling that perfectly balances the potent garlic butter glaze. Typically, it’s made with a soft, slightly sweet bread, often a milk bread or brioche bun, which is deeply cut into six wedges without going all the way through the bottom. These cuts are then generously filled with a creamy, tangy-sweet cream cheese mixture. Finally, the entire bread is dunked or brushed liberally with a luscious garlic butter concoction, often containing a hint of honey or condensed milk, before being baked until golden and fragrant. The result is a symphony of textures and flavors: a crispy exterior, a soft, fluffy interior, a rich, cool cream cheese center, and an aromatic explosion of garlic and butter in every bite. It’s no wonder this particular Korean cream cheese garlic bread has become an iconic street food and bakery item.

## Ingredients You'll Need

To embark on your Korean cream cheese garlic bread journey, gather these essential ingredients. Quality ingredients make all the difference for this delightful Korean baking project.

For the Bread:
*   6 soft bread buns (brioche buns, milk bread buns, or even burger buns work well)

For the Cream Cheese Filling:
*   8 oz (226g) cream cheese, softened
*   1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar (or more, to taste)
*   1 large egg yolk
*   1-2 tablespoons milk or heavy cream (for smoother consistency)
*   1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract (optional, but enhances flavor)

For the Garlic Butter Glaze:
*   1/2 cup (113g) unsalted butter, melted
*   4-6 cloves garlic, minced very finely
*   1/4 cup (60ml) milk or heavy cream
*   2 tablespoons honey or condensed milk (adjust to sweetness preference)
*   1 large egg
*   1-2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish and flavor)
*   Pinch of salt

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Follow these steps carefully to create your own irresistible Korean cream cheese garlic bread at home.

1.  **Prepare the Bread:** Take each soft bread bun and make six deep cuts from the top, radiating outwards like spokes on a wheel, but do not cut all the way through the bottom. You want the base to remain intact, holding the "petals" together. Set aside.

2.  **Make the Cream Cheese Filling:** In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, egg yolk, milk/cream, and vanilla extract (if using). Use a hand mixer or whisk to beat until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, with no lumps. Transfer this filling into a piping bag fitted with a wide round tip, or simply use a spoon if you don't have a piping bag.

3.  **Fill the Bread:** Carefully open up the cuts in each bread bun and generously pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling into each crevice. Don't be shy – the more filling, the better! You can also spread a little on top if desired.

4.  **Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze:** In another bowl, whisk together the melted butter, finely minced garlic, milk/cream, honey/condensed milk, egg, and a pinch of salt. Mix until all ingredients are well combined. Add the chopped fresh parsley to the mixture.

5.  **Glaze the Bread:** Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Carefully pick up each filled bread bun and dunk it entirely into the garlic butter glaze, ensuring all surfaces, especially the cream cheese-filled crevices, are thoroughly coated. Alternatively, you can place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and generously brush the glaze over every part of the bread.

6.  **Bake:** Place the glazed bread buns on the parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown, the garlic butter is bubbling, and the cream cheese filling is set and slightly puffed. Keep an eye on them to prevent burning.

7.  **Serve:** Let the Korean cream cheese garlic bread cool slightly before serving. It’s best enjoyed warm!

## Tips for the Perfect Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread

Achieving bakery-quality Korean cream cheese garlic bread is easier with a few insider tips:

*   **Bread Choice is Key:** While brioche or soft milk bread buns are ideal, you can experiment with other soft, slightly sweet rolls. The softness is crucial for absorbing the glaze and providing a pleasant texture.
*   **Don't Skimp on Cream Cheese:** Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing to prevent lumps and achieve a silky smooth filling. A generous amount of filling makes the bread truly decadent.
*   **Finely Mince Garlic:** For the best flavor distribution and to avoid large chunks of raw garlic, use a garlic press or mince your garlic very, very finely.
*   **Sweetness Adjustment:** Taste your cream cheese filling and garlic glaze before assembly. Adjust the sugar/honey to your preference. Some prefer it sweeter, others lean more savory.
*   **Even Coating:** Ensure every nook and cranny of your bread is coated with the garlic butter glaze. This is where most of the savory-sweet flavor comes from, creating that irresistible crust.
*   **Parchment Paper is Your Friend:** The garlic butter glaze can drip and burn, so always line your baking sheet with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
*   **Serve Warm:** This bread is truly at its peak when warm, right out of the oven. The contrast of the warm bread and the slightly cooled, creamy filling is divine.

## Serving Suggestions

Korean cream cheese garlic bread is incredibly versatile and can be enjoyed in many ways. It makes a fantastic standalone snack or a delightful addition to a brunch spread. Serve it alongside a hot cup of coffee or a refreshing iced tea for a perfect afternoon treat. It also pairs wonderfully with a light salad for a more complete meal, or even as a unique appetizer at a gathering. Its comforting, rich flavors make it an excellent comfort food for any time of day.

## Variations & Substitutions

Feel free to get creative with your Korean cream cheese garlic bread!

*   **Spice it Up:** Add a pinch of red pepper flakes to the garlic butter glaze for a subtle kick.
*   **Herbal Infusion:** Beyond parsley, try adding chives, dill, or even a touch of dried oregano to the glaze or cream cheese for different aromatic profiles.
*   **Cheese Please:** While cream cheese is traditional, you could mix in a small amount of shredded mozzarella or Parmesan into the cream cheese filling for an extra layer of savory depth.
*   **Sweetener Swaps:** Instead of granulated sugar, use powdered sugar for an even smoother cream cheese filling. For the glaze, maple syrup can be a delicious alternative to honey.
*   **Bread Alternatives:** If you can't find milk bread buns, consider using a small baguette cut into segments and then cross-cut, or even thick slices of challah bread.
*   **Savory Twist:** Reduce the sugar in the cream cheese filling and add a pinch of onion powder or finely chopped green onions for a more savory version.

This delightful Korean cream cheese garlic bread is more than just a recipe; it's an experience. The journey of making it is as rewarding as the first bite. With its unique blend of sweet and savory, creamy and garlicky, it's a dish that promises to impress and satisfy. So, roll up your sleeves, gather your ingredients, and prepare to create a truly unforgettable piece of Korean baking magic in your own kitchen!
